risk_note: RV1/RV2 by path (apps/admin; config items include business and payout parameters, the page only edits through the server's checks). Admin config center: groups in registry order, edit allowed by the row's permission point, drawer edit with type checks and a required reason, config.risk / config.business through the shared totp step-up, expected_version CAS (20902 re-read), history and rollback to lower versions only, batch edit limited to one point and to the items the operator changed, amounts typed in yuan as text (at most two decimals, trailing zeros included) and converted to whole fen with @couli/money, unknown write results re-read never re-sent. Rule tests by Codex in three calls (67 tests; round 2 after the Claude spec-test review S1s: rollback name per the board, no reason column, exact-fen amount cases; round 3 an exception for three tests that read the table while the step-up modal hid it), red on the test machine (red/3). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in three rounds (round 3: the Codex review findings on amount normalisation and the batch submitting untouched items). Test machine verify-fast/8 and browser/6 green. Reviews: Codex only (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 fail (S1 InputNumber normalised 12.340 past the two-decimal check; S2 batch sent an untouched never-written boolean as false), fixed in implementation round 3; round 2 pass, both closed, no new findings
